name: DESIGN.md generator for Figma
summary: Figma plugin that extracts the open file's styles and variables and generates editable DESIGN.md and SKILL.md for AI tools.
description: A Figma plugin that reads local styles and variables from the current file - colors, typography, spacing, radius, motion, effects, grids and component families - and generates editable DESIGN.md and SKILL.md markdown for tools such as Google Stitch, Claude Code and Codex. Actions cover auto-extract, generate, toggle view, refresh and download; the SKILL.md output carries WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility rules and quality gates.
contains: extracts colors, typography, spacing, radius, motion, effects, grids and component families from the active Figma file
generates editable DESIGN.md and SKILL.md files
actions: auto-extract, generate DESIGN.md, generate SKILL.md, toggle view, refresh, download
SKILL.md applies WCAG 2.2 AA requirements and defines quality gates
runs as a local development plugin in Figma Desktop
